name: Supreme court
description: Follow Supreme court, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Are Trump’s Official Papers His Personal Property?
changes.summary: The administration argues that presidential papers are like those of Supreme Court justices.

changes.title: Supreme Court Stands Up to Trump on Mail Voting and a Few Key Issues
changes.summary: The justices take their time and pick their spots, but they have rejected presidential initiatives on tariffs, citizenship, the National Guard — and now the coming election.

changes.title: Supreme Court Blocks Trump Administration Plan to Screen Mail-In Ballots
changes.summary: The Trump administration had asked the justices to allow a new Postal Service plan to screen ballots just weeks before the midterm elections.

changes.title: With Trump’s Plans Blocked, States Work to Restore Trust in Mail Voting
changes.summary: President Trump’s efforts to restrict mail voting ahead of the midterms were thwarted by the Supreme Court, but they have sowed confusion and doubt among some voters.

changes.title: The Supreme Court Is Considering Trump’s Mail Voting Plan. Here’s What to Know.
changes.summary: The administration’s plan to screen mail-in ballots remains blocked as the Supreme Court reviews challenges to new U.S. Postal Service ballot rules.

changes.title: Supreme Court denies Trump’s mail-in voting restrictions
changes.summary: The Supreme Court rejected President Donald Trump’s attempt to restrict mail-in voting ahead of the midterm elections. NBC News’ Monica Alba explains the decision.

changes.title: The Supreme Court rejects Trump's mail voting restrictions for this year's midterms
changes.summary: The Supreme Court has rejected the Trump administration's request to allow mail-in voting restrictions under a U.S. Postal Service plan for the midterm general election. (Image credit: Patrick T. Fallon).

changes.title: As Supreme Court Weighs Trump Mail Ballot Plan, Another Judge Blocks It
changes.summary: The ruling by a lower court judge was another blow to President Trump’s effort to make voting by mail harder. The Supreme Court is also considering the Trump plan.

changes.title: Supreme Court Again Blocks Republican-Backed Missouri Voting Map
changes.summary: The ruling deferred to the state’s Supreme Court, which had invalidated G.O.P.-friendly district lines, saying voters must first have an opportunity to approve the map in a statewide referendum.

changes.title: Sam Bankman-Fried Asks Supreme Court to Review Fraud Conviction
changes.summary: The disgraced founder of the crypto exchange FTX is serving a 25-year prison sentence.
